subject: Kickoff: pre-training vs specialized architectures study
body:
Hi Alina,

Kicking off the semantic parsing generalization study. Basis is our published comparison of pre-training vs. specialized architectures for compositional generalization; the ask from leadership is an updated, internal-model version: does scale-plus-pre-training still beat purpose-built parsers (CGPS and friends) on MCD-style splits, and by how much?

Product angle: this directly informs whether the parsing features in two roadmap items use a fine-tuned general model or a bespoke architecture. A clear answer saves a team-quarter either way.

Milestones (Apr 20 – Jul 13): harness + data prep by mid-May, main sweep done end of June, write-up and recommendation by Jul 10. The original experiments ran on single V100s, so per-run cost is small — it's the sweep breadth that adds up.

Alina, over to you for staffing + compute.

Lucia
